title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Company Description
Skoolarz is a cloud-based school management platform designed to simplify and connect K–12 operations for administrators, teachers, and parents. By centralizing attendance, grading, scheduling, and communication, Skoolarz reduces manual work and minimizes breakdowns in information flow. The platform is built on modern, scalable architecture and provides real-time analytics and reporting to support informed decision-making across schools and institutions. Guided by the values of efficiency, collaboration, innovation, and trust, Skoolarz focuses on creating intuitive, data-informed tools that make schools easier to run. The company is committed to building solutions for the future of education, helping partners deliver more connected experiences in every aspect of school management.
Role Description
The UI/UX Designer at Skoolarz will design intuitive, user-centered interfaces for web and mobile experiences within the school management platform. This full-time, on-site role in Amman involves collaborating with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to translate requirements into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes. The designer will conduct user research and usability testing, refine user flows, and ensure visual consistency across all features and modules. Daily responsibilities include creating design systems, documenting interaction patterns, and partnering with front-end developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs. The role also includes iterating on existing interfaces based on user feedback and data, and contributing ideas that enhance usability and accessibility for diverse user groups in K–12 education.
Qualifications
Strong user experience design skills, including User Experience Design (UED) and the ability to map user journeys, define information architecture, and optimize workflows.
Proficiency in visual design and mockups, with experience creating clean, consistent interfaces, design systems, and UI components.
Hands-on experience with prototyping, using industry-standard tools to build interactive prototypes and support usability testing and stakeholder reviews.
Working knowledge of front-end development concepts (HTML, CSS, basic JavaScript) to collaborate effectively with engineering and ensure feasible, implementable designs.
Experience with user research and usability testing methods; ability to translate qualitative and quantitative insights into design improvements.
Familiarity with accessibility and responsive design best practices for web and mobile platforms.
Bachelor’s degree in design, HCI, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present design rationale to cross-functional teams and incorporate feedback constructively.
Prior experience designing SaaS or education technology products is a plus.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Job Brief
We are looking for a junior UI/UX designer to join our design team and work directly with our senior designer. This is a hands-on role focused on the user interfaces of our software products. Beyond product work, you'll also contribute to ABS's visual presence, creating social media graphics, marketing posters, brochures and presentation templates that reflect our brand. You will start by supporting live work — wireframes, screens, design assets, and prototypes — and grow into owning your own pieces as you develop. It is a strong opportunity for someone at the very start of their career who wants to learn product design properly, with a senior designer mentoring them day to day.
What You'll Do
Produce wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes for product features under the guidance of the senior designer
Build and maintain UI screens and design assets, keeping them consistent with our design system and brand
Turn requirements and rough sketches into clean, usable interface designs
Help organize and extend the design system (components, styles, patterns)
Incorporate feedback from the senior designer, product, and development teams through review cycles
Prepare design handoffs for developers and support them during implementation
Design social media graphics and digital assets for ABS's online channels
Create and update company presentation templates and slide decks
Required
What We're Looking For
0–1 year of experience in UI/UX or product design (internships, freelance, or strong academic/portfolio work all count)
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or Visual Communication, or equivalent
A portfolio showing UI design and an understanding of user-centered thinking — quality of thinking matters more than years
Working knowledge of Figma (our primary design tool)
Knowledge of Adobe Suite (Photoshop, illustrator, indesign) and other design softwares like Canva
Solid grasp of layout, typography, color, and visual hierarchy
Eagerness to learn, take feedback well, and grow under mentorship
Good communication in English and Arabic
Nice to Have
Familiarity with design systems and component-based design
Basic understanding of how designs get built (HTML/CSS awareness, developer handoff)
Exposure to enterprise or B2B software interfaces
Interest in prototyping and interaction design
Application Requirements
Please include a link to your design portfolio or examples of your work showcasing UI/UX projects for web and mobile platforms.

title: Product Designer
description:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world-class provider of multi-asset fintech products - from liquidity solutions to in-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
"At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our
Product department
would like to welcome a detail-oriented.
Product Designer
in our office in
Amman
As a Product Designer at Equiti, you’ll work within one of our product pillars to design end-to-end experiences – from early discovery and concepts through to polished, production-ready designs. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and fellow designers, contributing to and building on our shared design system. This is a hands-on role for a designer who combines strong craft with sound product thinking and thrives in a fast-moving, multi-market environment.
Responsibilities
Design end-to-end user experiences across mobile and web – from user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity UI and prototypes
Translate product requirements and user insights into clear, well-reasoned design solutions
Collaborate with product managers and engineers throughout discovery, definition, and delivery
Contribute to and work within Equiti’s design system, ensuring consistency and quality across products
Participate in user research and usability testing, using findings to iterate and improve designs
Design for a global audience, including multilingual and RTL (Arabic) experiences
Present work clearly, give and receive feedback constructively, and iterate quickly
Support design QA during implementation to ensure shipped experiences match design intent
Skills & Competencies
Strong visual and interaction design skills with a portfolio demonstrating shipped digital products
Proficiency in Figma, including components, variables, and prototyping
Solid grasp of UX fundamentals – information architecture, usability principles, and accessibility
Ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints
Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting and defending design decisions
A collaborative, low-ego working style with genuine curiosity about users and the product domain
Interest in fintech, trading, or investing is a plus; experience designing RTL interfaces is a bonus
Experience Requirements
3+ years of experience as a product designer working on consumer-facing digital products
Experience working in cross-functional product teams within an agile environment
Experience contributing to or working within an established design system
Experience in fintech, trading, or other regulated industries is an advantage
Perks
Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
Competitive salary package
Performance-based bonus
Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
Smart working options
Employee wellness initiatives
Personalized career development
Company lunch in the office
Regular company events
With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
“Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Location : Amman , Jordan
Requested Number : 6 Vacancies
Contract Type : Full Time
About Jo Academy
Jo Academy is a pioneering EdTech Company founded in 2014, offering a comprehensive digital learning platform across Jordan and the region. We serve diverse age groups through an integrated, interactive learning experience designed for national and international school students, as well as university learners.
Powered by AI and cutting-edge technologies, Jo Academy enables personalized and adaptive learning journeys that respond to different needs and learning styles. Today, we support over two million learners through thousands of interactive lessons and educational resources.
Jo Academy is a member of ULA Group, alongside ULA KSA, and contributes to a broader vision of integrating emerging technologies, such as AI-powered adaptive learning, AR/VR, and virtual schools, into the education ecosystem in the region and beyond.
Our Purpose
Jo Academy is driven by a clear purpose: to make education accessible, seamless, and engaging. Our mission focuses on increasing knowledge, building skills, and personalizing digital learning experiences. Through tech-enabled education, we are committed to empowering Arab learners, expanding their opportunities, and advancing digital education to better serve our community.
Our Values
At Jo Academy, we foster a culture of innovation, creativity, and impact. As a leader in the EdTech field, we are committed to delivering meaningful products and services that truly make a difference.
Our team is passionate, diverse, and excellence-driven, united by a shared belief in the power of education and technology to shape the future.
About The Role
We are currently seeking to hire an instructional designers who think like creative storytellers and experience designers, individuals who can transform scientific and academic concepts into engaging videos, educational games, and visually rich digital learning experiences for school students to join our ID Team
.
This role reports to the
ID Manager
and works closely with internal teams, teachers, and students to support the smooth execution of operational and administrative activities related to international programs.
If you’re passionate about blending education with creativity, storytelling, and modern visual culture, this role is for you
Key Responsibilities
Write creative educational storyboards for videos that connect academic and scientific concepts to real-life contexts.
Transform textbook content into engaging visual learning experiences inspired by contemporary media and digital storytelling techniques.
Generate ideas for educational games, simulations, and virtual experiments.
Design entertaining edutainment content across a variety of school subjects.
Contribute to the development of creative standards and learning experience guidelines for innovative educational products.
Create instructional templates that maintain quality and consistency across learning materials.
Apply modern instructional design models, learning theories, pedagogical strategies, and e-learning best practices in creative ways.
Collaborate closely with subject matter experts, animators, and media production teams to bring learning experiences to life.
Qualifications
Holds a Bachelor’s degree in fields such as Science, Mathematics, Languages, or related disciplines.
Has at least 2 years of experience in instructional design, e-learning, or educational content creation.
Possesses strong storytelling, scriptwriting, and educational writing skills.
Thinks creatively and visually, with the ability to enrich academic content through engaging presentation styles.
Understands how modern learners interact with digital media and online content.
Can simplify complex ideas into compelling and accessible educational narratives.
Appreciates visual culture, pacing, engagement strategies, and learner psychology.
Understands instructional design principles and learning theories, and knows how to apply them creatively rather than traditionally.
Demonstrates strong editing, communication, organization, and time-management skills.
Works effectively across creative, educational, and production teams.
Utilizes AI-powered tools to support the creation of engaging educational experiences and learning content
Recruitment Statement
Due to the large amount of recived applicants , Only qualified and shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
At Jo Academy, we are committed to equal opportunity, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

description:

At Namaa, we build and operate tech-enabled urban infrastructure that gives consumers fast, reliable access to meals, groceries, and everyday essentials.
Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today’s digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.
We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That’s why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.
Our ecosystem is driven by a portfolio of specialized business units, including
KitchenPark
,
CloudRetail
, and
Profood Properties
, each playing a key role in enabling brands to grow and thrive in an increasingly on-demand world.
What You’ll Do
As the Brand Creative Manager, you will be responsible for managing the day-to-day execution of our brand across digital and marketing channels. You will ensure our visual identity, social media presence, and creative assets remain consistent, engaging, and aligned with our brand standards.
Working closely with Marketing and business stakeholders, you'll oversee the planning and delivery of creative projects, guide the development of content across multiple brands, and help shape how our brand is represented online. This role combines people management with hands-on creative leadership, making it ideal for someone with a strong design or creative background and experience creating high-quality digital and social media content.
Key Responsibilities
Leading the creative for the company, providing direction, feedback, and support to ensure high-quality creative output.
Act as a lead, hands-on designer and personally executing high-priority graphic design projects.
Oversee the planning and execution of creative projects across social media, digital marketing, employer branding, and company initiatives.
Maintain and evolve the company's visual identity, ensuring consistency across all brands and customer touchpoints.
Review and approve creative assets, including social media content, videos, presentations, and marketing materials.
Collaborate with Marketing and cross-functional teams to develop creative campaigns that support business objectives.
Guide the visual direction of social media content, ensuring designs and messaging align with brand standards and platform best practices.
Prioritize and allocate creative work across the team to ensure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
Stay informed on design trends and social media best practices, introducing new ideas that enhance brand visibility and engagement.
Monitor the performance of creative campaigns and use insights to continuously improve future content and creative execution.
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Multimedia Design, Marketing, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or creative marketing.
Previous experience managing or mentoring a small creative team.
Strong understanding of branding, visual identity, typography, layout, and design principles.
Proven experience creating and overseeing creative assets for social media, digital marketing, and brand campaigns.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with tools such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, or Figma.
Experience collaborating with marketing and cross-functional teams to deliver creative campaigns that support business objectives.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.
What Else You Need To Know
This role is based in our Amman office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.
Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

title: User Interface Designer
description:
Robot24 | Dubai, Business Bay | Full-time | On-site
At
Report24
, we're building products that challenge traditional workflows.
We're looking for a
UI Designer
who is passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences.
Not someone who simply follows trends.
Not someone who only knows how to use design tools.
We're looking for someone who can take an idea, understand the vision behind it, and transform it into a beautiful, intuitive, and production-ready interface.
If you obsess over details, love solving design problems, and enjoy working in a fast-moving environment where ideas evolve every day, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Do
You'll work directly with our product and leadership team to design modern web applications, SaaS platforms, marketplaces, dashboards, and internal tools.
Your responsibilities will include:
Transforming ideas, discussions, and rough concepts into polished UI designs.
Designing intuitive user interfaces that are both beautiful and highly functional.
Building and maintaining scalable design systems.
Creating responsive designs for desktop and mobile.
Producing developer-ready designs with clear components and specifications.
Iterating quickly based on feedback and evolving product requirements.
Thinking beyond individual screens to create a consistent product experience.
Collaborating closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.
Who We're Looking For
You have exceptional visual design skills and understand that great UI is more than choosing nice colours.
You think about typography.
Spacing.
Hierarchy.
Alignment.
Consistency.
Accessibility.
Motion.
Micro-interactions.
Every pixel matters.
You ask questions before making assumptions.
You enjoy understanding the problem before designing the solution.
Most importantly, you genuinely care about creating products that people love using.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We're looking for someone who:
Has outstanding UI and visual design skills.
Has a strong portfolio of modern SaaS, marketplace, or web application designs.
Pays extraordinary attention to detail.
Can convert complex workflows into simple, elegant interfaces.
Works quickly without compromising quality.
Is comfortable with frequent design iterations and evolving requirements.
Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
Communicates clearly and collaborates well with cross-functional teams.
Is proactive, curious, and always looking for better solutions.
AI Is a Tool — Not the Designer
We welcome designers who embrace modern technology.
If AI helps you automate repetitive work, explore ideas faster, organise information, or speed up your workflow, that's a huge advantage.
However, we believe creativity, design thinking, taste, and attention to detail cannot be automated.
The best designers know what to delegate to AI—and what requires human creativity and judgement.
We're looking for someone who uses AI to become more efficient, not someone who relies on AI to do the creative thinking.
Tools & Skills
You don't need experience with every tool below, but you should be comfortable working in a modern product design environment.
Preferred experience includes:
Figma (Expert)
Framer
Rive
ProtoPie
FigJam
Miro
Design Systems
Component Libraries
Auto Layout
Responsive Design
Interactive Prototyping
Developer Handoff
Modern AI-assisted design workflows
This Role Probably Isn't For You If...
You primarily rely on AI-generated designs without adding your own creativity.
You need extensive direction before getting started.
You struggle with changing requirements or rapid iterations.
You focus mainly on UX research while visual interface design is secondary.
You produce "good enough" work rather than striving for exceptional quality.
You overlook the small details that elevate a design.
Bonus Points
You'll stand out if you have experience with:
SaaS products
Marketplaces
Enterprise applications
Dashboard design
Design systems at scale
Motion design and micro-interactions
Working closely with frontend developers
Designing products from concept to launch
What We Offer
Work on products used by businesses around the world.
High ownership and creative freedom.
A fast-moving environment where your ideas matter.
Opportunity to shape products from the ground up.
A collaborative team that values quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Long-term growth opportunities.
Important
Your portfolio is the most important part of your application. Please apply only if your work demonstrates exceptional visual UI design, originality and strong attention to detail.
To Apply
Please submit:
• Your portfolio
• Your CV or LinkedIn profile
• A short explanation of the project in your portfolio that best represents your UI capabilities
Location: Dubai, Business Bay
Employment type: Full-time, on-site

title: Product Designer
description:
JUSTLIFE
PRODUCT
DUBAI, UAE
Product Designer
Design the experience millions of people across the UAE and KSA use to run their homes.
Every month, hundreds of thousands of people across the GCC book a cleaner, a beauty service, a handyman, or a healthcare visit through Justlife. The moment they tap through, the trust they place in letting someone into their home, that is what you will design.
We are looking for a Product Designer who treats craft and speed as the same goal, who has shipped consumer software at scale, and who wants to help build the most loved super app for home services in the region. You will have the room to own the problem, not just the screen.
The Role
You will own the design of key product areas end to end. Research, flows, prototypes, the shipped experience, and how it holds up once real people use it. You will drive all of it alongside product and engineering every day. You will report to the Design Manager and have a real say in what we build and why, not just how it looks.
The work spans every side of the marketplace. Clients booking and paying, professionals managing their availability and jobs, and the internal teams keeping every service moving. The journeys you could own sit across that entire experience, including payments, availability, assignment, CRM, fulfilment, and the flows that connect them.
This is not a role where you decorate decisions someone else has already made. We want you involved in the problem early, challenging weak ideas before they reach a screen, pushing back when the easy design is the wrong one, and taking ownership of the outcome the experience drives, not just the screens you hand off.
We also want you working the way the best designers work today, with AI doing real work at every step, from research synthesis to rapid prototyping. We are pushing hard to become an AI native product team, and the person in this role will play an active part in that shift rather than simply keeping up with it.
Why This Work Matters
Since 2015 we have been digitalising home services across the GCC. Today that means 25K+ service professionals whose livelihoods are routed through flows you will design, and millions of households who trust us to make their homes run. Get the experience right and you improve both sides of a real two-sided market, a problem the regional giants cannot copy simply by spending more.
What You'll Do in Your First 6 Months
Ship a core surface. Own one area, funnel, matching, or payments, across UI and UX, and get it live
Set the benchmark. Run a competitor and market study and define the design bar for your surface, measured against the best, not guessed
Ground it in real insight. Run user interviews and service-professional (crew) interviews, and turn what you learn into shipped design
Build AI into your workflow. Use AI tooling to move faster from idea to high-fidelity prototype, and show the team how
How We Work
Prototype-driven. We put things in front of people fast and iterate
Benchmark-led. We know what the best in the category look like, because we study them
Research-grounded. Decisions come from user and crew interviews, not opinion
Design-system mindset. Consistency and reusability, not one-off screens
AI in the craft. AI tooling is genuinely built into how this team designs every day, from research synthesis to rapid prototyping
What We're Looking For
Must-haves
3–5 years of experience as a Product Designer, ideally working on consumer mobile, marketplace, or two-sided platform products
Excellent visual design craft. You have a strong eye for typography, spacing, hierarchy, composition, interaction, and detail. Your portfolio should demonstrate polished, production-ready mobile interfaces, not just solid UX thinking
Strong end-to-end UI and UX skills. You can take a feature from problem definition and exploration through to final design and implementation, explaining the decisions you made along the way
A portfolio that shows meaningful ownership. We want to see the specific role you played, how you approached the problem, how the design evolved, and the impact of the final solution
A benchmark-driven approach. You actively study the best products in a category, understand what makes them effective, and use those learnings to raise the quality of your own work
A user-centred mindset. You use research, feedback, data, and real user or crew insights to inform your decisions, and can share examples of how those insights changed your design
Demonstrable AI fluency. You can name the AI tools you use, explain exactly where they fit into your workflow, and show how they have improved your speed, exploration, or output quality. Generic claims will not pass screening; specifics will
Nice-to-haves
Experience designing for marketplaces or products with two-sided user journeys
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or scale-up environment
Experience using AI as part of the design craft, not only as a feature within the product
Experience working closely with engineers to maintain visual quality through implementation
How We'll Evaluate You
We run structured interviews using a shared scorecard, so you know exactly what we are evaluating: visual and interaction design quality, speed of iteration, depth of benchmark analysis, rigour in user and crew research, and how you navigate ambiguity and take ownership. Every interviewer assesses the same dimensions, with no guesswork or shifting expectations.
Why Justlife, Why Now
We started in 2015 by digitalising home cleaning in the UAE. Today we operate across 10+ cities in the UAE and KSA, with 200+ full-time employees, 6K+ service professionals, and over 15 million sessions delivered. The experience we have today got us here. The experience you'll design is what gets us to 10x.
If you've ever redesigned a flow that moved conversion, if you sweat the 200ms and the one extra tap, if you want your work used by millions across the region, talk to us.
Justlife is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on craft, evidence, and potential, and we welcome applicants of every background, nationality, and gender.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.
Who you are
We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Product Designer who will own how the Geotab Video Platform looks, feels, and works, driving design initiatives end-to-end for our AI dashcam and video intelligence software. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!
What you’ll do
As a Senior Product Designer, your key area of responsibility will be driving design initiatives across cross-functional teams to shape the product design vision, creating complex data-heavy surfaces (such as live video review, safety timelines, and fleet dashboards), and championing our design system. You will need to work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, and senior leadership. To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter with strong communication skills, excellent UX judgment, and a high degree of autonomy who thrives in a fast-paced environment. In addition, the successful candidate will have 5-8 years of product design experience with deep knowledge of Figma, responsive web application patterns, and a strong portfolio of shipped products.
How you’ll make an impact
Responsible for driving design initiatives in cross-functional teams, promoting cross-functional collaboration and ensuring the seamless integration of design solutions throughout the product development lifecycle.
Take a proactive role in identifying opportunities to enhance design capabilities and effectiveness, initiating improvements in design methodologies, tools, and workflows to optimize efficiency and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Conduct research, user testing, and analysis to gain deep insights into user behaviors, preferences, and pain points, guiding the development of user-centered design solutions.
Take responsibility for knowledge sharing within the design team, mentoring and supporting junior designers to foster their professional growth and excellence.
Advise manager on user-centric design principles and best practices, ensuring that design solutions align with user needs and industry standards.
Gather requirements and align design efforts with business objectives, actively seeking opportunities to improve the overall product experience.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and design best practices, continuously evolving design skills and knowledge.
Advise on design concepts and communicate ideas effectively to stakeholders, presenting design solutions and justifying design decisions based on user research and data.
Work independently with developers and product managers to ensure the successful implementation of design solutions, providing guidance and support throughout the development process.
Champion the adoption and evolution of a design system, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive its implementation and maintenance by establishing and encouraging the adoption of design system guidelines.
Lead efforts within a cross-functional team to advocate and contribute to our design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across products and platforms.
Mentor earlier stage designers across the design team; leveling up the team, helping to improve best practices, processes and tooling.
Help build a high-functioning design team and culture; contributing to hiring processes, providing thoughtful feedback in design critiques, identifying internal and external opportunities to level up design at Geotab.
What you’ll bring to this role
5-8 years of relevant industry experience owning product design end-to-end for shipped software, ideally in B2B, SaaS, telematics, video, or another data-rich domain.
A portfolio of shipped products that reached real users, with clear evidence of the parts you personally owned.
Relevant Bachelor’s Diploma/Degree or equivalent industry experience (Degree specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or related field preferred).
Deep knowledge of product design, including UI design proficiency, modern design systems, prototyping, interaction patterns, responsive web applications, and expert command of tools like Figma.
Strong UX judgment grounded in research with the ability to lead all aspects of user-centered design, conduct usability testing, and analyze behavior data to drive decisions.
Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate complex ideas, defend design decisions with reasoning and data, and engage across all levels of the organization.
Self-starter and adaptable team player comfortable with high-intensity workloads, minimal supervision, and collaborating daily with product and engineering teams.
If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Head of Product Design
description:
CASABOT is The AI Home. A privacy-first, local-intelligence platform built on four architectural commitments — HiveOS™, BOTty™, Augmented Reality, and on-device AI with no cloud dependency. Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, with operations expanding into Italy.
The role
We are hiring a Head of Design to own product design and user experience across the CASABOT platform. The role reports to the Chief Executive Officer and inherits a small in-house team of two.
This is a hands-on leadership seat. The Head of Design will contribute directly to the work, set the visual and interaction language for the platform, and build out the team over the next twelve to eighteen months. The trajectory is genuine — strong performance in the role positions the seat to evolve into Chief Design Officer.
What you will own
•       Product design across the full CASABOT surface stack — HiveOS UI, BOTty interaction, mobile (iOS and Android), web, and the Augmented Reality experience.
•       The CASABOT design system — patterns, components, accessibility standards, and design tokens.
•       Brand stewardship — visual identity, motion language, and the consistency of how CASABOT shows up to customers, partners, and the public.
•       Cross-functional partnership with the acting Chief Technology Officer, mobile engineering leads, and the Chief Revenue Officer on customer-facing surfaces.
•       Hiring, mentoring, and growing the design organisation as the company scales.
First ninety days
Three priorities, in order:
1.     HiveOS UI — the in-home control surface customers and installers see every day.
2.     Mobile — iOS and Android apps as the primary remote and management touchpoint.
3.     BOTty interaction — the conversational and behavioural design that defines the CASABOT personality.
Year one and beyond
Expand ownership into web, the Augmented Reality experience, and full brand-system stewardship. Build the team — hiring decisions are yours to recommend and lead. Establish design as a peer function alongside engineering and commercial.
Required experience
•       Senior product design experience leading multi-platform consumer products.
•       Proven track record of shipping at quality and on schedule in a startup environment.
•       Direct experience hiring, leading, and developing design teams.
•       Deep, hands-on fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools.
•       Comfort owning end-to-end work — research, interaction, visual, prototyping, and design QA.
•       Track record of building and maintaining design systems at scale.
Preferred experience
•       Smart home, consumer hardware, connected devices, or premium hospitality technology.
•       Multi-surface design — mobile, web, embedded, and one or more of: spatial, AR, or voice.
•       Brand-system fluency and the ability to partner with, or replace, agency support.
•       Prior exposure to working in or near the Gulf region, or to expanding businesses across Europe.
We are open to candidates from other backgrounds, including software-as-a-service, where the work is strong and the appetite for our product space is genuine.
The temperament we need
CASABOT is a startup. The Head of Design must work both smart and hard — meeting deadlines is not optional, and the pressure is constant. We need a leader who delivers under load, makes decisions when information is imperfect, holds the line on quality, and does not break when timelines tighten. We are direct, ambitious, and we ship.
Location and working arrangement
Based in the United Arab Emirates is strongly preferred. Remote candidates with substantial overlap to the Gulf Standard Time business day will be considered. Some travel to the UAE will be required.
Compensation
CASABOT offers a competitive base salary calibrated to seniority and experience.
Stock options form an integral part of the compensation package
— the Head of Design will participate meaningfully in the company’s equity programme. Specific figures, equity allocation, and vesting terms will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.
Process
Direct applications only. CASABOT is not engaging recruitment agencies for this search.
Shortlisted candidates will meet with the Chief Executive Officer, the acting Chief Technology Officer, and other senior members of the leadership team.

title: Senior Product Designer (Design Systems)
description:
About the Company
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.
About The Role
Careem’s design system underpins every product experience across the super app, including rides, food, groceries, payments and beyond. We’re looking for a Design System Lead to own its evolution through its next chapter: one where the system serves not only designers and engineers, but AI agents that consume, generate and assemble design.This is a hands-on senior IC role for someone who is both a rigorous systems designer and a capable AI tool-builder. You’ll govern the token architecture, component library and documentation that keep a multi-vertical platform coherent, and you’ll use AI to make the system faster to maintain, easier to adopt and smarter to build with.
What You’ll Do
Own the Design System
Own the lifecycle of Design System’s tokens, components, and patterns: from inception through shipping, iteration, and deprecation.
Define and enforce standards for color, type, spacing, and interaction across platforms (iOS, Android, web) and locales, including RTL/Arabic.
Resolve ambiguity regarding organizational ownership and responsibilities by maintaining a clear, intentional token architecture.
Establish and maintain comprehensive documentation, specifically addressing identified needs for detailing appropriate guidance to ensure cross-component consistency.
Champion accessibility (WCAG) as a system-level guarantee and manage the backlog with product and engineering partners.
Make the System AI-native
Structure tokens and components so agentic design-to-code and prompt-to-design workflows produce on-system output.
Build and maintain Code Connect mappings, MCP integrations, and structured component metadata.
Implement AI-assisted audits and linting to catch off-system usage and token misuse before they ship.
Use AI to keep documentation verified and versioned alongside the components it describes.
Prototype Figma plugins and agent workflows to remove repetitive tasks for the wider design team.
Drive Adoption and Enablement
Articulate the system’s value in efficiency and quality to stakeholders ranging from ICs to executives.
Facilitate design system guilds and critiques, and synthesize cross-vertical feedback into prioritized improvements.
Raise the organization's AI proficiency through workshops and training material.
Partner and Influence
Work closely with engineering to translate design patterns into deployable components, ensuring technical feasibility.
Apply judgment to manage component bloat; for example, maintaining separate architectures (like Quick cards) when merging variants creates excessive technical complexity.
Collaborate with stakeholders to align on design system goals and product strategy.
What You'll Need:
5+ years experience in product design, with at least 3 years dedicated to design systems at scale (ideally, multi-brand or super-app environments).
Advanced knowledge of variables, token architecture, component APIs, library management, and branching.
Demonstrated experience building real workflows with LLMs and agentic tools (e.g., Figma Plugin API, MCP-based integrations, or prompt design).
Ability to prototype in JavaScript/TypeScript, JSON, and manage design token pipelines.
Ability to distinguish semantic intent from value coincidence and manage complexity through unification.
Excellent English writing and presentation skills.
Bonus Points
Experience with RTL/Arabic-first products or the Middle East market.
Experience with production design-to-code pipelines (Code Connect, token transformation).
Active participation in the AI × design community (open-source contributions, speaking, or writing).
What We’ll Provide You
We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

We are looking for a UX/Concept Designer who can shape that experience end to end: the platform interface, the user journeys, and how our AI agents actually behave, sound, and respond when a real person is talking to them.
This is a hands-on design role inside a technical team. You will work daily alongside AI Engineers, the Integration Engineer, and the Platform Architect, not handing off a finished design and walking away, but staying involved through to what actually gets built.
What You Will Design
The user interface of the FFL platform, including layout, navigation, and interaction patterns, using a consistent design system
End-to-end user journeys across the platform, from onboarding through everyday use
Conversational and agent interaction patterns: how our AI agents communicate confidence, limitations, and handoff to a human
Multilingual experiences, including Arabic, for agents and interfaces used across the region
Prototypes and concepts that get tested and validated before engineering time is committed to building them
What You Will Do
Design the FFL platform's UI and user journeys, working from concept through to build-ready handoff
Design how our AI agents and AI Teammates communicate, including conversational flow, tone, and recovery when an agent gets something wrong
Work directly with AI Engineers and the Integration Engineer to make sure your designs are technically implementable, not just visually appealing
Maintain a design system and reusable component library for the FFL platform
Run lightweight user research and usability testing to validate design decisions
Design with Arabic and multilingual use in mind from the start, not as an afterthought translation pass
What You Bring
A strong portfolio of UX/UI and concept design work that you can walk us through in detail. This is a hard requirement, applications without a portfolio will not be considered
Demonstrable experience designing for software platforms, ideally SaaS, enterprise, or platform products
Experience working with Microsoft technologies (Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or Copilot Studio interfaces). This is a hard requirement, given the Microsoft-first stack we build on
Experience designing end-to-end user journeys, not just individual screens
Strong communication skills, with demonstrable ability to work directly with engineers and technical architects through to delivery
A working understanding of how frontend and backend systems interact, sufficient to design solutions that are realistic to build, not just visually appealing
Nice to Have
Experience designing for AI, agent, or conversational interfaces, particularly where you have shaped how an AI system communicates with users
Experience with dynamic, AI-generated, or personalised content design, where the interface adapts to model output rather than static content
Arabic language skills, written and spoken. This is a strong advantage given our multilingual customer base and the need to design conversational patterns and user journeys that work naturally in Arabic, not just translated from English
Based in Saudi Arabia, or willing to relocate
Familiarity with accessibility standards for enterprise software
How We Work
Sulava MEA is a Frontier Firm: fast, clear, and deeply collaborative. Our culture is built on trust, expertise, and action. We value people who think boldly, deliver impact, and raise the bar for modern AI engineering and the experiences we build on top of it.
You will have access to top Microsoft expertise, MVP-level mentorship, ongoing learning opportunities, and projects that matter. Benefits include health insurance, flexible working arrangements, a professional development budget, and relocation support where applicable.
Additional Application Requirements
Portfolio of Work
Please include a link to your portfolio. We want to see real, shipped work wherever possible, not only concept or student projects. Walk us through a small number of projects in depth rather than listing many briefly: what the problem was, what you designed, and what changed as a result.
Optional Video Introduction
Please include a link to a short video introducing yourself and your design approach. The video does not need to be professionally produced, a simple recording is perfectly fine.
Our Interview Process
First interview: a portfolio review with the Head of Build and a member of the Build technical team, to understand your design thinking and how you have worked with engineers before
Additional interview: may be required depending on what you showcase in your first interview
Final interview: with the Head of AI Build at Sulava

تأسست
"إكستند"
بقناعة واحدة: يجب على التقنية أن تُوظف لتقريب المنظمات من الناس. ومع مرور السنوات، تطورت الأدوات وتغيرت التقنيات، لكن هذه القناعة بقيت ثابتة. بفضول مستمر، يدفعنا أكثر لفهم احتياجات المجتمع، استطعنا أن نحقق نتائج تستجيب لطلبات عملائنا وتدعم أهدافهم.
نبحث عن أشخاص لا يكتفون بأول فكرة، ولا بأقرب حل، ويمنحون كل مشروع ما يستحقه من تفكير وعناية.
نبحث في "إكستند" عن مصمم جرافيك للعمل مع فريقنا.
دورك الأساسي صياغة قصص مرئية وتجسيد أفكار إبداعية في تصاميم تعيش وتلفت الانتباه. تصاميم تعتمد على حسك الفني، وفهمك العميق لمنصات التواصل والثقافة المحلية.
المسؤوليات والمهام الرئيسية:
• تصميم وتطوير المواد الإبداعية للمنصات الرقمية، وسائل التواصل، والمطبوعات.
• بناء الهويات البصرية وتطوير أنظمة العلامات التجارية مع ضمان اتساقها في كل التطبيقات.
• إعداد التخطيطات البصرية والتكوينات الخطية لتعبر عن الرسالة بوضوح.
• توظيف أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي الحديثة في توليد الأفكار والتصورات المبدئية وتحسين جودة العمل.
• التعاون المباشر مع المدراء الفنيين وكتاب المحتوى وفريق إدارة الحسابات لتنفيذ حملات متكاملة.
• ضمان دقة التصاميم ومطابقتها لهوية العميل، وتسليم أعلى جودة فنية في موعدها.
• تجهيز الملفات النهائية بصيغها الصحيحة للطباعة أو النشر الرقمي.
المؤهلات والمهارات المطلوبة:
• بكالوريوس في تصميم الجرافيك أو مجال مشابه.
• خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات كمصمم في وكالات التسويق والإعلان.
• احترافية في برامج التصميم.
• فهم عميق لنظرية الألوان، شبكات التصميم، الخطوط، والتكوين البصري.
• شغف وفضول لتجربة أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي الموجهة للتصميم واكتساب مهاراتها.
• عين ثاقبة للتفاصيل، ومتابعة مستمرة لأحدث اتجاهات التصميم العالمية والثقافة البصرية.
• قدرة على إدارة الأولويات، العمل تحت الضغط، والتعاون بروح الفريق.
ما ينتظرك في إكستند:
مسؤولية حقيقية وعمل يُنسب إلى أصحابه
نتوقع منك أن تتطور، ونوفر لك كل ما يساعدك على ذلك
دعم صحي وأسري لأن الحياة لا تنتهي على أعتاب المكتب
حوافز طويلة المدى لأن نجاحنا لا يكتمل إلا إذا كنت جزء منه
إذا كنت ترى نفسك في هذا الوصف، فريقنا ينتظرك!

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
About The Job
HungerStation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
Job Description
About the Role
We’re looking for a UX Researcher who’s equal parts analytical, empathetic, and bold, someone who thrives in uncovering user insights through both structured analysis and real-world fieldwork. This role is central to ensuring that every HungerStation product decision is backed by deep user understanding, not assumptions.
You’ll plan, conduct, and synthesize user research across all stages of the product lifecycle, working closely with designers, product managers, and data analysts to bring user stories to life, from data to documentation and from insights to action.
What You’ll Do
Lead end-to-end research initiatives, from defining goals and selecting methods to conducting studies, synthesizing findings, and communicating insights.
Conduct in-field and remote research with real users across Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region, including intercept interviews, contextual inquiries, and usability sessions in public spaces or on-call.
Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify patterns and trends in user behavior.
Balance qualitative and quantitative methods, such as in-depth interviews, diary studies, surveys, analytics deep-dives, and A/B test evaluation.
Document findings thoroughly through structured reports, visual frameworks, and presentation decks that drive design and product decisions.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and analytics to ensure research insights are timely, actionable, and measurable.
Advocate for users by communicating insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders, translating empathy into impact.
Build scalable research frameworks to improve consistency, speed, and rigor across the team.
Examples of Research You Might Lead
Running in-person usability sessions in Riyadh’s busiest malls to test the onboarding flow for new users.
Conducting delivery rider shadowing and diary studies to understand post-order experience pain points.
Analyzing survey and app analytics data to uncover churn reasons and improve retention.
Facilitating concept testing workshops with product and design teams to validate early ideas before development.
Leading feature validation studies for new product launches or key initiatives within our Food, Quick Commerce, or FinTech domains.
Developing deep-dive reports on specific user segments (e.g., first-time users, loyal customers, or vendors) to guide domain or product strategies.
Qualifications
Fluency in English required; Arabic proficiency mandatory
5+ years of experience in UX Research or Human-Centered Design, ideally within product-driven or fast-paced tech environments.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Design, or a related field.
Expertise across qualitative and quantitative research methods such as usability testing, ethnographic studies, concept validation, surveys, and heuristic evaluations.
Strong analytical and documentation skills, able to distill complex findings into clear, structured reports with visual storytelling and actionable recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions across product and tech teams.
Comfortable and confident conducting fieldwork, talking to random users in public, visiting vendors, or running in-person sessions when needed.
Familiarity with tools such as Maze, Qualtrics, Dovetail, Typeform, Looker, Excel, or Google Data Studio.
Experience with design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD.
Good understanding of user-centered design principles and practices.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative mindset.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage time effectively.
Additional Information
Please include your portfolio or research case study when sharing your CV.

description:
Background
Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.
Why
Everyone worries about the dooms-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.

Create low-fidelity wireframes, user flows and interaction frameworks to explore ideas quickly
Develop high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes that are production-ready and scalable
Translate complex technical and operational requirements into simple, easy-to-understand user journeys

Develop, maintain, and evolve a library of reusable UI components, patterns, and design guidelines
Create clear interaction diagrams, wireframes, and prototypes that communicate intent effectively to cross-functional stakeholders
Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to ensure feasibility and consistency
Iterate rapidly on designs based on feedback, usage insights, and real-world constraints

Present design work clearly, articulating rationale, trade-offs, and user impact
Balance speed and quality while managing multiple design tasks in parallel

Bachelor’s degree or diploma in UI/UX design, interaction design, HCI, visual communication, or a related field
Strong portfolio demonstrating interaction design depth, systems thinking, and visual clarity
Excellent fundamentals in typography, layout, color, hierarchy, and information design
Proven ability to quickly create clear diagrams, wireframes, flows, and prototypes with a strong interaction point-of-view

Experience collaborating with cross functional teams

Prototyping skills

description:
About ClearGrid
ClearGrid is revolutionizing the debt resolution industry with cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics. We leverage real-time data, machine learning, and automation to optimize debt recovery for financial institutions.
About The Role
Our AI agents hold thousands of conversations with customers every day, in Arabic and English, by voice and chat. We are looking for our first Arabic-speaking Conversation Designer: the person who makes sure the cultural and linguistic nuance of Arabic is a strength of our product, and that Arabic quality keeps pace with English as we scale.
You will join the conversation design team, reporting to the Conversation Design Manager, and lead the design of our Arabic AI agents: designing them, reviewing them, and setting the bar for what excellent Arabic sounds like in our product. You will be the team’s authority on Arabic conversation quality, and you will also contribute across the wider design workload: structuring requirements, designing conversations in both languages, and handing prompt engineers everything they need to build.
What you’ll own
Design conversations for new AI agents, voice and chat, for new and existing clients: conversation flows, dialogue structure, copy, and edge case handling.
Lead Arabic conversation design: design, review, and launch Arabic agents, and serve as the team’s authority on the linguistic and cultural quality of Arabic conversations.
Produce complete handover packages for prompt engineers: requirements, conversation designs, and guidelines that allow implementation to start without open questions.
Track and analyze agent performance with the analytics team, report on the impact of design changes, and recommend the next optimizations for each agent.
Run conversation quality reviews on live agents, covering the conversational quality dimensions that sit outside compliance QA.
Write and maintain our conversation design standards and methodology, and improve the internal processes the function runs on.
Your work directly influences our north-star metric: conversion of promises-to-pay into kept promises.
What we’re looking for
At least 1 year, ideally 2+, of conversation design experience on production chatbots and/or voice agents. Hands-on experience shipping a production bot is essential; pure UX copywriting without it is not enough for this role.
Arabic fluency with a deep feel for its linguistic and cultural nuances. You can hear what is off in a conversation and articulate why.
Comfort working with data: tracking, monitoring, and reporting on agent performance to prove the impact of your design decisions.
A high level of ownership and personal effectiveness. You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where structure is still being built.
Rigor and attention to detail. You treat documentation, reviews, and quality checks as core parts of the craft.
A curious, informed point of view on where voice AI and conversational interfaces are heading.
Nice to have
A background in Arabic linguistics.
Experience in fintech, collections, or outbound operations.
Hands-on experience with voice agents specifically.

Position Overview
NAZ is seeking a detail-oriented Shop Drawing Designer & Technical Coordinator to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing accurate, coordinated, and production-ready shop drawings for bespoke furniture, architectural woodwork, doors, kitchens, wardrobes, wall cladding, and other custom joinery solutions.
Working from architectural drawings, interior design packages, consultant details, and client requirements, the role involves conducting site measurements, preparing as-built documentation, coordinating technical details, and producing high-quality shop drawings for client approval and factory production.

* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Architecture, Interior Design, Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of experience preparing shop drawings for bespoke furniture, architectural woodwork, or interior fit-out projects.
* Strong understanding of joinery construction methods and furniture manufacturing.
* Excellent knowledge of wood materials, veneers, laminates, HPL, solid timber, engineered boards, metals, glass, stone, upholstery, hardware, and their technical integration.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and interior design drawings.
* Strong understanding of production methods, assembly techniques, and installation requirements.
* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Technical Skills
* AutoCAD (Advanced)
* Microsoft Office
* SketchUp and/or Rhino (Preferred)
* Inventor, SolidWorks, Cabinet Vision, Mozaik, or similar manufacturing software (Preferred)

Core Competencies
* Technical drafting and detailing
* Architectural coordination
* Production-oriented thinking
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and coordination skills
* Time management and ability to work on multiple projects
* Commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement

title: Product Manager
description:
About us:
MBC GROUP is the leading and largest media company in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, that is home to over 17 leading TV channels, two radio stations, and Shahid – the world’s leading Arabic streaming platform.
Shahid MBC is a leading digital platform in the Middle East, providing high-quality streaming services for a diverse range of content. We are committed to delivering exceptional user experience and expanding our offerings to meet the evolving needs of our audience.
Position Overview:
We are seeking a Product Manager with a strong user experience mindset and a passion for crafting intuitive, engaging, and delightful digital experiences. The ideal candidate will play a key role in elevating Shahid’s user experience across all touchpoints — from onboarding and navigation to playback and engagement — driving measurable improvements in the overall user experience.
This role sits within the Experience & Engagement stream and requires close collaboration with internal teams (Design, Research, Engineering, Data, and Business) to translate user insights into seamless, high-quality product experiences across Shahid’s web, mobile, and TV platforms.
Key responsibilities and accountabilities:
Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for user experience improvements across Shahid’s web, mobile, and TV applications.
Partner closely with UX/UI designers and researchers to translate user insights, usability testing, and behavioral data into actionable product requirements.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Business, engineering, design, and marketing, to deliver high-quality experiences on time.
Manage product documentation, requirement gathering, and execution follow-ups for new features, experience enhancements, and design system adoption.
Define, run, and analyze A/B tests and experiments to validate design decisions and optimize the user experience.
Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and user feedback analysis to identify trends and opportunities for experience enhancements.

Champion accessibility, localization (including Arabic-first RTL experiences), and platform consistency across all user touchpoints.
Foster innovation and ensure efficient collaboration across teams.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field; Master’s degree is an advantage.
7+ years in product management with a proven track record in consumer-facing digital or platform-based products.
Demonstrated experience improving user experience across multi-platform products (web, mobile, TV), ideally in streaming, media, or entertainment.
Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with hands-on experience in leveraging analytics and experimentation tools for decision-making.
Solid understanding of UX design principles, usability testing, user research methods, and design systems; familiarity with tools such as Figma is an advantage.
Experience in delivering use cases, journey maps, gap analysis, and functional requirements.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to advocate for the user across the organization.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Product Designer - UI/UX
description:
Design the interfaces for AI products used by governments and large enterprises across the GCC, at a level of craft that stands next to the best software being made anywhere, in two languages that read in opposite directions.
About Xpin AI
Xpin AI builds sovereign AI for governments, enterprises, and institutions across the GCC. Our products are bilingual at their core, spanning Arabic, English, and regional languages, and ship into both on-premise sovereign environments and cloud. Design here is a genuinely hard problem rather than a finishing layer: our users are making consequential decisions with a system whose output is probabilistic, so clarity, trust, and bilingual fluency are not polish, they are the product.
The role
You own the interface design for products across our suite. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will not be writing decks about design, you will be drawing the screens, building the components, and sitting with the engineers who ship them.
The bar is high and worth being explicit about. We are looking for the level of craft where typography, spacing, hierarchy, and motion are decided rather than defaulted, where the interface feels obvious to use and considered up close, and where nothing looks like it came out of a template. Most enterprise software in this region does not clear that bar. That is precisely the opening.
What you'll design
Product interfaces end to end.
Flows, screens, states, and the edge cases that never appear in a portfolio shot: empty, loading, partial, failed, and the long tail of real data.
Interfaces for probabilistic systems.
AI output is not deterministic. You will design how a system streams an answer, shows what it is doing and why, expresses confidence and uncertainty, and lets a user verify or correct it. There is little established pattern language here, so you will be defining it.
Real-time and voice experiences.
Conversational and voice-driven interfaces where timing, feedback, and interruption are part of the design rather than an afterthought.
Dense, information-heavy surfaces.
Dashboards and analytical views where the job is to make complexity legible for people who use the product all day, not to simplify it away.
The design system, alongside the Design Lead.
Components, tokens, and the typographic and spacing foundations, built in Figma so they translate cleanly into code rather than needing reinterpretation.
Bilingual design at system level.
Arabic and English as genuinely equal experiences: mirrored layouts, correct Arabic typography and numerals, type scales that work across two scripts with different rhythms and no shared italic convention. This is one of the hardest and most interesting parts of the job.
Motion with intent.
Transitions and micro-interactions that communicate state and causality, specified precisely enough to be built as designed.
What good looks like here
Typography is treated as a primary tool, not a setting. You have opinions about type scale, measure, and optical alignment, and you can defend them.
Spacing and layout follow a system you can articulate, and the system holds up under pressure rather than being abandoned on the hard screens.
Restraint. You know what to leave out, and your interfaces do not decorate to appear designed.
Your files are structured well enough that another designer or an engineer can pick them up without asking you what anything means.
You design the whole thing, including the states nobody screenshots.
Tool stack
Core design:
Figma at depth, including variables and modes, component properties and APIs, auto layout, library architecture, and Dev Mode for handoff.
Prototyping:
Figma prototyping for flows, with ProtoPie or Framer where an interaction needs real logic, timing, or conditional state to be evaluated properly.
Design systems and tokens:
Tokens Studio for token management, feeding a Style Dictionary pipeline maintained with our frontend engineers. Semantic token architecture, theming, and multi-mode systems that support both language directions.
Motion:
Rive or Lottie for production motion, authored so engineers implement what you designed rather than approximating it. After Effects where the pipeline calls for it.
Typography and localisation:
Arabic and Latin type pairing, variable fonts, type scales that hold across two scripts, RTL mirroring, bidirectional text behaviour, and font licensing suitable for embedded and offline distribution.
Accessibility:
WCAG 2.2 AA as a working standard, contrast and colour tooling such as Stark, keyboard and screen reader flows considered at design time rather than retrofitted.
Vector and assets:
Illustrator, Affinity, or equivalent for icon and mark work, custom icon system design, SVG optimisation, and asset formats that survive offline bundling.
Frontend literacy:
enough React, Next.js, Tailwind, and CSS logical properties to design within real constraints, read a component implementation, and have a precise conversation about why something rendered differently than drawn.
Collaboration and documentation:
Figma Dev Mode alongside Storybook, Git and GitHub at the level of reviewing a token or component change, and clear written specs and design system documentation.
Research and validation:
usability testing and structured critique, with tools such as Maze or UserTesting where the question warrants it.
Exploration:
whatever gets you to a better answer faster, including AI tooling for early ideation, provided the final work is deliberate rather than generated.
Level and scope
Mid to Senior, roughly five or more years designing digital products. What matters is the work: we will hire a designer with four years and an exceptional portfolio over one with ten and a competent one. You will own the design of your assigned product areas, work directly with product managers and engineers, and have real influence on what gets built, not just how it looks. This is a craft role with a path to grow.
Must-have
A portfolio of shipped product work with visible craft: considered typography, deliberate spacing and hierarchy, and interfaces that hold up when you look closely. This is the primary filter and we will look carefully.
Depth in Figma, including component architecture, variables, and building for reuse rather than assembling one-off screens.
Experience designing complex or information-dense applications rather than only marketing sites or simple consumer apps.
Design systems experience: you have built or meaningfully contributed to one and understand tokens, not just component libraries.
Ability to explain your decisions. You can walk through why a layout is the way it is, in terms a non-designer can follow, and change your mind when the argument is better.
Comfort working closely with engineers, and interest in how the thing actually gets built.
Based in the UAE or willing to relocate to Dubai, and comfortable working on-site.
Nice-to-have
Arabic or RTL design experience, including Arabic typography. Arabic language ability is a plus but not required.
Design for AI products: conversational interfaces, streaming responses, agent transparency, or voice.
Motion design produced to a production standard using Rive or Lottie.
Accessibility practice against WCAG standards, which our public sector deployments require.
Enterprise, government, or other complex operational software, where users are trained and constraints are real.
Data visualisation and dashboard design at scale.
Ability to build a working prototype in code, or comfort in a design engineering role.
Experience designing under offline constraints, including font licensing and asset bundling.
Why join
Very little software in this region is designed to the standard we are aiming for, and the products here are worth the effort: AI systems that people use to make real decisions, in a language pairing most design teams never seriously attempt. The Arabic and English problem alone is a body of work most designers never get to do properly.
You will work alongside an engineering team that cares about implementation fidelity, on a design system being built from the foundations rather than inherited. Your work ships into real government and enterprise environments across the GCC rather than into a backlog, and you will be close enough to the engineering to see it built the way you drew it.
Compensation and logistics
On-site in Dubai. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to your experience and the UAE market. The package includes UAE employment visa sponsorship, medical insurance, and annual leave and flight allowance per UAE labour law and company policy. Relocation support is available for candidates joining from outside the UAE. Xpin AI hires on demonstrated ability and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.
How to apply
Send your portfolio. For this role it matters more than anything else on your CV, so lead with your best three to five pieces of shipped product work rather than everything you have made. We want to see the reasoning as well as the outcome: what the problem was, what you tried, what you cut, and what you would change now. Case studies with process beat galleries of finished screens. If you have a personal project that represents your ceiling better than your client work does, include it. We review portfolios properly and will give you a real response either way.
