title: Senior UX Designer
description:
Who We Are
VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
We're looking for a skilled and confident Senior UX Designer to join our Customer Experience team in an embedded capacity with one of Saudi Arabia's leading banks. This is a hybrid role that sits at the intersection of product thinking and visual craft, you'll be involved in shaping what gets built
and
how it looks and feels.
You'll be working within the client's Riyadh office, collaborating directly with their product and design teams day-to-day, while remaining a valued member of the VML agency team, joining department meetings, contributing to team culture, and benefiting from the development and support structures the agency provides.
This is a rare kind of embedded role. The client is mature from a design perspective, with a well-established design system, a product-oriented mindset, and a working culture that genuinely respects and enables good design. You'll have the conditions to do your best work.
You'll spend your time contributing to product definition, understanding user needs, shaping product direction, and designing experiences, as well as producing high-quality UI that works within and extends an established, comprehensive design system. You'll be one part product designer, one part visual craftsperson, and entirely focused on delivering experiences that serve millions of banking customers across the Kingdom.
What you'll do
Contribute to the definition and shaping of digital banking products, working alongside product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into experience solutions.
Design intuitive, considered user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI that align to the client's established design system.
Apply and work confidently within an existing design system, using components correctly, maintaining visual consistency, and flagging genuine gaps to the appropriate system owners.
Translate business and user requirements into clear, well-reasoned design solutions that balance user needs with commercial and technical constraints.
Collaborate with a cross-functional client team including product managers, developers, and other designers, contributing meaningfully to sprint cycles and product planning.
Communicate design decisions with clarity and confidence to stakeholders, backing up recommendations with evidence and rationale.
Work across multiple product areas or features simultaneously, managing your own time and priorities in a fast-paced product environment.
Participate in regular VML department meetings and contribute to the wider CX team's knowledge sharing, culture, and development.
You will have
6+ years of experience in UX and product design, with a portfolio that demonstrates both strong product thinking and high-quality visual design.
Proven experience working in a product environment within a corporate or enterprise organisation, you understand how products are built, how teams are structured, and how to work effectively in that context.
Solid experience working with and applying a comprehensive, established design system, you respect the system, work within it effectively, and know how to flag exceptions without undermining consistency.
Experience with user research, whether you've led it yourself or contributed as part of a team, you're comfortable with qualitative methods and using insight to inform design.
The ability to contribute at both the definition and execution stages of a product, you're as comfortable in a discovery workshop as you are in Figma refining a final screen.
Strong visual design skills with a clear eye for detail, hierarchy, and consistency.
Experience collaborating directly with clients and client-side teams, building relationships and working with autonomy and professionalism.
The ability to work independently in an embedded setting while remaining connected to and contributing to a wider agency team.
Experience in financial services, banking, or similarly regulated, large-scale product environments is a strong advantage.
You will be
Based in Riyadh, or willing to relocate
A native Arabic speaker
Willing to dedicate normal working hours (9-6), not in parallel with other working commitments.
Willing to spend time in the office each working day.
About The Team
You'll be joining VML's 20+ strong MENA CX department, spread across three countries and made up of visual designers, UX architects, researchers, and strategists. Although you'll be embedded with the client in Riyadh, you'll remain a full member of our team, attending regular department meetings, contributing to our culture, and benefiting from the skills frameworks, mentorship, and growth opportunities the agency offers.
The client environment itself is one of the best you'll find in the region. This is a design-mature organisation that has invested seriously in product and design capability. They have an established design system, a collaborative team culture, and a genuine respect for the value of good design. You'll have the support of both the client team around you and the VML agency behind you.
Why This Role is Different
Embedded agency roles can vary enormously. This one stands out. The client is experienced, design-forward, and committed to building products the right way. You won't be fighting for a seat at the table, design already has one. You'll be working in a well-structured product environment with a design system that works, a team that collaborates, and stakeholders who understand what UX is for.
At the same time, you'll keep the benefits of being part of an agency, variety, community, development frameworks, and a team of specialists to learn from and grow alongside.
If you're a hybrid designer who wants to work on products that matter, in an environment that enables great work, and with the backing of both a world-class client and a leading global agency, we'd love to hear from you.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: BIM / CAD Modeler (Revit)
description:
About The Company
At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.
Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly capable
BIM/CAD Modeler
with a specialized focus on
Interior Design and Technical Detailing
. You will support the design and delivery of Flow’s projects across the MENA region, translating ambitious design intent into highly accurate, coordinated Revit BIM models and CAD documentation.
The ideal candidate possesses a "design eye" and understands that a great model is more than just geometry, it’s about the fine details of joinery, material transitions, and furniture integration. You will be the bridge between conceptual interior design and technical execution.
Core Responsibilities
Detailed Modelling: Develop and maintain Revit BIM models specifically for high-end architectural and interior design packages.
ID Documentation: Produce comprehensive Interior Design construction packages, including furniture plans, floor finishes, reflected ceiling plans (RCP), power, lighting, plumbing, elevations, and section details.
Joinery & Millwork: Create detailed drawing packages for bespoke joinery, kitchens, and furniture, ensuring technical feasibility and design alignment.
Scheduling & Tagging: Prepare and manage complex schedules for doors, windows, ironmongery, and joinery.
Specification Integration: Interpret FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment) and material specifications provided by the design team, ensuring all items are correctly coded, tagged, and reflected in the Revit model and drawing sets.
Coordination: Facilitate "clash-free" design by coordinating interior elements with structural and MEP disciplines within the BIM environment.
Standards Management: Maintain Revit families and templates, ensuring all ID-specific components (furniture, lighting, finishes) align with Flow’s BIM protocols.
Compliance: Ensure all drawings comply with local Saudi building codes and Flow’s internal design standards.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technology, Engineering, Interior Design or related field.
Experience: 3-6 years of experience, with a proven track record in Interior Design documentation and high-end real estate or hospitality projects.
Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit & AutoCAD is mandatory, with a strong knowledge of AutoCAD for 2D drafting.
Experience working in BIM environments, including model coordination and LOD development.
Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of furniture construction, millwork detailing, and how different materials (stone, wood, metal) interface in an interior setting.
BIM Fluency: Experience in model coordination, LOD (Level of Development) 300-400, and working within shared CDE (Common Data Environments).
Bonus Skills: Familiarity with Navisworks, Rhino, or SketchUp.
Ability to work in fast-paced development environments with multiple concurrent projects.
Excellent organizational and communication skills.
What We Look For
Precision & Artistry: A meticulous eye for detail—you spot a 5mm misalignment before anyone else does.
Detail-oriented thinkers who take pride in precision and clarity in technical documentation.
Technical Sensitivity: The ability to read a material spec sheet and understand exactly how to tag and represent it in a technical drawing.
Collaborative Spirit: A team player who enjoys the "back-and-forth" with designers and engineers to solve complex site problems.
People who are energized by building something new and meaningful.
Individuals who combine technical discipline with design sensitivity.
Why Join Flow?
Exciting growth opportunity:
Be part of a fast-growing company shaping the future of residential living in the Middle East.
Competitive Compensation & Benefits.
A chance to make an impact:
Help build a vibrant international community and redefine what it means to call Flow home.
If you have the energy, talent, and work ethic to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you! Apply now and be part of Flow’s success story!

title: Product Designer
description:
At Procreate we're dedicated to making exceptional creative tools by combining beautiful user experiences with high performance engineering! Used by millions around the globe, Procreate is committed to placing more power in the hands of creatives.
We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our team here in Hobart. You’ll collaborate to deliver incredibly powerful tools through user friendly and intuitive user interfaces. Every aspect of our product design is meticulously thought through and iterated. Your approach to design will reflect this pursuit of excellence and relentless attention to detail.
The role
This role sits within the Product team, and you’ll report directly to the CPO, Claire d’Este. You’ll work closely with the CEO, Co-Founder, and Chief Product Designer, James Cuda. You’ll also work with other designers in both the product and marketing departments as well as our software engineers.
You’ll bring a skill set which combines technical fluency in a range of software tools, a creative flair, an ability to ideate, and a drive to design industry-leading products. You’ll work directly on Procreate as it continues to evolve and our next generation products.
What you'll do
Create and document processes and procedure.
Build out our design system, workflow and component library.
Maintain and build upon our existing design principles and language.
Work with designers, engineers and creatives to produce work of the highest quality.
Create beautiful and intuitive user experience. In your role, you’ll take big-picture ideas from concept to design.
Design a range of digital components that will improve design efficiency and allow designers to work within a consistent framework.
Skills
A background and significant experience in design. We appreciate a multi-disciplinary approach to design and value technical proficiency coupled with an ability to be creative, curious and playful. Your work will demonstrate how you have included elements of graphic design, motion design, and animation into the UX/UI of a range of digital products.
Creative flair and an inquisitive approach to design. Our aim is to engage, delight and spark joy in our users. Your work will sit squarely at the apex of functionality and aesthetics. You’ll be able to harness your technical proficiency, passion for design and a creative X-factor to execute a wide range of design deliverables.
A focus on detail and a desire to grow. It is important to us that you have a laser-like eye for detail and a hunger to learn. You’ll have the ability to collaborate with a diverse group of designers and engineers to produce pixel perfect work. Your ability to focus on the iteration and reiteration of high-fidelity prototypes alongside your colleagues will be crucial to your success in this role.
What to expect in the first 6-12 months
Complete the Procreate onboarding process and get to know your colleagues.
Build an understanding of our product design practices, processes and frameworks.
Establish relationships with inter-departmental key stakeholders.
Prepare and support the execution of key design projects.
Become an integral and contributing part of the Product Design Team and ship product.
We want to hear from you
We’d love to hear about how you see yourself contributing to Procreate in this role. Please note, we're looking for full-time and on-site employees for our Hobart or Sydney office. Apply now to be considered for the role!

title: Product designer
description:
Hungry for a challenge?
That’s good, because at SKIP we have abundant opportunity or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe.
Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers.
About This Role
As a Product Designer at SKIP, you'll be part of a UX team looking after the apps and websites our customers and partners use for delivery of food, groceries and more!
You’ll work with an empowered cross-functional team that prioritises using research and data to help understand the problem space, before moving through the design process to deliver engaging and user-friendly solutions.
We want to discover what our users will love as soon as we can. We like to explore user problems in-depth and we like to speak with users regularly, to explore what we are working on and help us understand their needs.
You'll be part of a passionate UX team of 80+ UX designers, UI designers, product designers, service designers, researchers and writers across 7 countries.
These are some of the key ingredients to the role:
Focus on key user problems and come up with innovative solutions to those problems.
Quickly yet thoroughly create process flows, user journeys, wireframes, visual design mock-ups and prototypes as needed to effectively conceptualise and communicate detailed interaction behaviours
Work across the entire product lifecycle from concept to delivery; creating documentation, wireframes, hi- & lo-fi prototypes and pixel perfect UI.
Collaborate with engineering & product management to build experiences and present your work to stakeholders
Collaborate on research alongside UX researchers, and conduct usability studies.
Collaborate and communicate with product management to build your design roadmap and manage timelines.
What will you bring to the table?
3-5 years of experience in a UX/UI design role.
Ability to execute on projects end-to-end from problem discovery, hi-fidelity designs, and developer handoff.
Experience working in agile/sprint-based environments.
Experience in regard to collaboration/projects with product, research and tech teams.
Ability to use AI tools to supplement existing design skills. You are able to discern good design practices versus AI-generated solutions.
Experience designing UIs for iOS, Android, and responsive web.
Experience working with and contributing to design systems and component libraries.
Experience with unmoderated user testing tools (Maze, usertesting.com)
High fidelity prototyping skills (Figma, etc.)
Comfortable presenting to larger audiences and senior stakeholders.
Experience with workshop facilitation and design sprints.
Ability to take ownership, creatively solve problems, and proactively contribute to the objectives of the business.
At JET, This Is On The Menu
Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.
Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.
Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.
What else is cooking?
Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.
Note
All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Toronto or Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.
Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

title: Product Designer
description:
TL;DR
We're looking for an AI-native product designer to work directly with the founders and across several brands. We're VC-backed and scaling fast, so this is a great opportunity to join early and grow with the company. If you're a smart, hungry and creative designer looking for real impact (with equity!), this could be a career defining role for you.
About Us
The Wild Ventures is a VC-backed startup that builds ecommerce products and AI services — ranging from a premium home decor brand (Wild Palace) to a B2B AI growth suite (Creator AI, LandingCreator.ai, Alex by Creator) as well as a growth and brand consultancy (thisisthewild.com).
That means one designer touches a lot of surface area: a B2B SaaS onboarding flow in the morning, a wallpaper video campaign in the afternoon.
The role
We are looking for a talented product designer who can own product interfaces and the marketing creative around them. This is deliberately a broad brief, and it only works because you are AI-native. The output we expect from one person is not achievable at traditional agency pace, so we need someone whose default reflex is to come up with the angle and then reach for the model, rather than the traditional manual process.
If you like being the only designer in the room and shipping fast across formats, you will enjoy it. If you want to specialize deeply in one discipline with a large design team around you, this is not the right seat.
You will report directly to the founders and work alongside engineering and ops.
Product design (roughly half your time)
Design end-to-end flows for our AI SaaS products: onboarding, dashboards, editors, billing and upgrade paths, while measuring what works and experimenting using data
Run UX audits and conversion work on the Wild Palace made-to-measure purchase flow
Build and maintain design systems that engineers can implement without hand-holding
Turn rough product direction into wireframes, prototypes and shipped UI
Brand and graphic design
Own and evolve visual identity across the portfolio, from typographically-led SaaS brands to a design-led interiors brand
Creative assets for product sites and agency engagements
Pitch decks, sales collateral, social assets and email design
Video and ad creative
Concept, edit and ship performance creative for platforms like Meta, YouTube, TikTok, AppLovin, Google and LinkedIn
Product demo videos, feature walkthroughs and short-form social video
Work with the growth side on creative testing: multiple angles, hooks and formats per campaign, then iterate on what the numbers say
AI-native production
Use generative tools to produce ad variants, product visuals and video at a volume that manual production cannot match
Build repeatable pipelines rather than one-off outputs: prompt libraries, reusable templates, consistent brand-locked styling across generated assets
Keep evaluating what is new. The tool you use in six months probably does not exist today, and we expect you to be the one telling us about it
You are probably a fit if
You have 2+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows real, shipped interfaces and not just concept work
You can move between SaaS and consumer ecommerce without flattening both into the same house style
You are fluent in the traditional stack (Figma, Canva, CapCut…) and equally at home in generative tools: Higgsfield, Midjourney, Runway, Veo, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, v0 or whatever has replaced them by the time you read this
You know where AI output is good enough to ship and where it still looks like AI output, and you have the craft to close that gap
You have made ads that ran, and you can talk about what performed and why
You work well with ambiguity and short briefs, and you push back when the brief is wrong
Nice to have
Front-end literacy: enough HTML, CSS and Tailwind to spec accurately or ship small changes yourself
Experience designing for both B2B SaaS and DTC ecommerce
Motion design or 3D product visualisation
Photography or art direction for lifestyle and interiors
What we offer
Direct ownership of design across a multi-company portfolio, with no layers between you and the decision
Real scope to shape how the brands look and how the products work
Equity in a VC-backed startup
How to apply
Send your portfolio and a short note to arvid@thewildventures.com, covering two things: the piece of work you are proudest of, and how AI tools actually sit in your process today. Be specific about the tools and what they replaced. We care far more about the portfolio than the CV.
Apply now

title: Product Designer
description:
About Programa
Programa is trusted by thousands of architects and interior designers in more than 90 countries. Our vertical SaaS platform helps designers run their business and projects more efficiently and brings their projects, processes, products and purchasing together in one place.
Position Overview
We're looking for a mid-level Product Designer who's as comfortable in a design file as they are shipping code. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, working closely with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery. The Product Designer is responsible for designing end-to-end product experiences with a strong focus on user interface (UI) design. The role works closely with the Engineering, Product, and Customer Experience teams to deliver high-quality features. The position requires balancing fast-paced delivery with attention to visual detail and usability, supporting a platform used by professional interior designers.
Designers in this role are required to go beyond design files; using Claude Code to independently ship quality of life improvements directly, closing the loop between design intent and real product impact. The entire product journey, from discovery through to delivery, is a seamless, collaborative effort across Design, Product, and Engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design of large product features end-to-end, from early concepts and wireframes through to thoughtful UX flows that guide users to the right path, and polished UI ready for engineering.
Work collaboratively with Engineers and Product Managers across the full product journey, from shaping and prioritisation through to build, review, and iteration, ensuring a seamless and unified process end-to-end.
Use Claude Code to independently ship quality of life improvements, enabling designers to move fast, close feedback loops, and take direct ownership of smaller but impactful product changes.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate design and delivery workflows, including partnering with Engineering to create and maintain relevant commands and AI workflows that enforce design system usage, so every product update stays consistent by default, not by manual review.
Help shape how product features are defined, validated, and prioritised, contributing to strategic product decisions as a core voice alongside Product and Engineering.
Contribute to structuring and evolving the design process while remaining comfortable with ambiguity and a fluid environment.
Ensure visual consistency, usability, and alignment with business goals across all design deliverables.
Support the development and maintenance of design systems and reusable components. • Conduct validation activities such as stakeholder reviews and lightweight research.
What we're looking for
3-5+ years of experience in SaaS product design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UI work
Exceptional UI craft; you care deeply about visual detail, consistency, and usability
Experience shipping in fast-paced product teams alongside engineers and PMs, with a curiosity about the intersection of design and code, and an eagerness to grow in that space
An openness to working closer to code than most design roles; this is a space we're growing into together, and we'll support you along the way
Experience with design systems and component-based design
A curiosity about how AI tools can change the way designers work; you don't need experience here, just an open mind
Strong communication skills and the ability to contribute to product decisions, not just execute on them
Comfortable with ambiguity and a fluid, evolving process
Bonus Experience
Experience designing for professional workflow-heavy products
Salary & Benefits
Competitive salary & ESOP
Flexible, hybrid work environment
Beautiful office in Richmond
Report directly to the Head of Design and work closely with the CEO and leadership.
A note about what happens after your submit your application
Every application is personally reviewed by a member of our team, no automated filtering here. We take the time to genuinely consider each candidate. We'll only be in touch with applicants whose experience and skills closely match what we're looking for at this stage. If you don't hear from us within 3 weeks, please take this as confirmation that we won't be moving forward with your application this time around.

title: Product Designer
description:
Role Description
In this role, you’ll be the customer's voice as you collaborate with Engineering, Product, Experience Research, Data Science, and business partners to build compelling products. You will solve problems with cross functional partners in collaborative teams, that enable designers to do their best work. As part of a product-driven and design-led company, you'll play a key role in a team of Product Designers owning core product development from inception to iteration and post-launch reflection. If you’re looking for scope, influence and the opportunity to do high-quality work in your next role, this is it.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
About The Design Team
We design the future of teamwork.
Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world’s teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.
Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We’re a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds
(product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting)
. We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centered design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.
We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.
Learn more about our team
Asana Design

Asana Design Instagram

Asana culture
Diversity, Inclusion, & Belonging
How we’ve designed a culture that fuels our business results

About You
3+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong thinking, craft, and iteration across onboarding, growth, or AI-powered product experiences.
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Strong prototyping skills and a maker mindset. You use prototypes regularly to explore ideas, test concepts, and drive collaboration.
Excited by highly collaborative product development and comfortable working closely with PMs and engineers throughout ideation and iteration.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and balancing incremental optimization work with longer-term product exploration.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with the ability to create polished, intuitive, and high-quality product experiences across every stage of the user journey.
What You’ll Achieve
Lead the design of end-to-end experiences for Asana products and features, with an emphasis on features for billing owners.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners to identify customer problems, establish vision, set strategy, build and ship solutions.
Champion product excellence. Elevate the quality bar for our experience and shape our payment design system.
Work across the organization to ship experiences that are cohesive with the broader Asana product experience, ensuring your design scales.
Facilitate and role model human-centered problem solving. Foster co-creation across the organization.
Learn new methods to solve deeply complex problems in the service of inventing new ways to deliver our customer benefits: flow, efficiency, engagement, and retention.
Help shape a product that is intuitive and elegant, which speaks from a unified voice.
What We’ll Offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: Product Designer (Mid-Level)
description:
Hey there! Thanks for stopping by. We're Airtasker, the tech company that connects people who need to get things done with those who have the skills to do it. Our mission is to empower people to realise the full value of their skills. This doesn't just apply to those who use our product. It's also for our whole team of go-getters who bring the product to life and deliver impact to our community on a daily basis. Because we believe work (and life) is always better when you truly know and appreciate your strengths and skills.
We're on the hunt for a
mid-level Product Designer
who's hands-on, AI-curious, and wired for shipping. You'll join a cross-functional team to elevate the customer experience across our product, owning problem spaces from start to finish. Some days that means building the solution yourself to move fast and learn. Other days it means crafting considered designs for engineers to build when the work is more complex.
We move quickly, so this role suits someone who's resourceful inside real constraints, treats prototypes as the fastest way to learn, and has the curiosity to use AI in both the product we ship and the way they work. You'll think holistically about the product (not just the design), form views on what we're shipping and why, and bring them to the table.
You'll have a support network of product designers, product managers, your design manager and engineers to help you grow in your craft and your career, delivering work you're genuinely proud of.
Join our team and help shape the future of Airtasker!
What You'll Do
Own problem spaces end-to-end. Coordinate with PMs, engineers and product marketing to define the work, then carry it from research through to shipped solutions.
Bring a product mindset. Care about what we're shipping and why, not just how it looks, and form views on roadmap, scope, success metrics and trade-offs.
Build, ship, learn. Get something tangible in front of real users early, whether a rough prototype or a thin slice of the live product, and let what you learn drive the next iteration.
Discover creative solutions inside real constraints. Time, scope, resourcing and tech debt are part of the job, so find creative paths to deliver high-quality work at pace.
Look for AI opportunities in our product and your own work. Spot ways AI can help our users in their daily lives, and adopt AI in your own design process to ship faster and explore more.
Rapidly prototype with AI. Move from flows and wireframes through to high-fidelity designs and AI-built front-end prototypes. No coding background needed, just the curiosity to use AI to get there.
Develop and iterate on interfaces with the right level of craft, balancing pragmatism with quality.
Run user research and validate hypotheses to deeply understand problems and shape what comes next.
Apply and contribute to the Airtasker Design System, raising the bar with your own work and feeding improvements back where it makes sense.
Bring your work to the team for feedback, and use design reviews to land on the right solution and execution.
We'd love to hear from you if you tick some of these boxes:
4-5 years of experience in product design.
A hands-on mindset and a real desire to use AI, both in the product you ship and in how you work day-to-day.
Solid foundation in product design fundamentals, with a portfolio that shows growth in visual interface design.
Effective cross-functional collaboration with PMs, engineers, product marketing and others.
Comfortable shipping high-quality work inside real constraints.
Proficient in Figma and comfortable designing for iOS, Android and responsive web.
Proficient in qualitative research, from discovery and prototyping to testing and iteration.
Cares about outcomes, not just outputs, and forms views on the product, not just the design.
Familiarity with marketplace dynamics is helpful, but not required.
Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback in design reviews.
Our People Experience
Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.
Thriving
Hybrid working - when it comes to working, there’s no “one size fits all” approach, with Airtasker you choose the environment that helps you do your best work.
Airtime - welcome to no Slack and meeting-free Fridays! Airtime is designed so we regularly have dedicated focus time for work and personal growth.
Recharge days - each quarter we have a company-wide Recharge Day, equivalent to 4 additional days of leave per year. It’s a day for everyone when the world can wait and self-care takes centre stage.
Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.
Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing
Rewarding
Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.
Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.
Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.
Belonging
DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.
Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.
Growing
Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.
360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.
Volunteer leave - Our team members can take a day each year to lend a helping hand and support a cause they are passionate about.
Celebrating
Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.
Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.
Birthday leave - All of our people get an extra day of leave during their birthday week to take time away from work to celebrate.
At Airtasker we believe in culture add - that each person is different and has their own background, learnings and unique experiences that can add to the Airtasker cultural tapestry. We pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.
To all recruitment agencies and talent suppliers: Airtasker does not accept unsolicited resumes. Airtasker is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job postings or directly to our managers. If you are on our supplier list and have terms in place, ensure you work alongside our internal TA team and do not send resumes directly to managers.

title: Product Designer
description:
Padlet is building software for a good education. A good education is one that inspires curiosity, creativity, and community. Our software enables that through visual content creation and collaboration in millions of classrooms worldwide.
There are some products that are so good, you feel delight using them. You wish you had more problems just so could use the products more. Think Dyson vacuum cleaner, a faucet with the perfect laminar flow, a sharp knife, WD40.
We aspire to build such products at Padlet, and are looking for a Product Designer to help us fulfill our aspirations. This is an in-person role in Singapore.
Responsibilities
Design of beautiful new products and features across mobile and web.
Coach less experienced designers in the design team.
Help hire more designers, if necessary.
Put Padlet in the hands of a billion people.
Qualifications
You like working hard.
You are honest.
You've designed beautiful software products.
Bonus: you have a good sense of humor.
About Padlet
Vision: Every child in the world will grow up with Mickey Mouse and Padlet.
Product: We are making the default way of collecting and sharing thoughts on the Internet. People love the product.
Impact: We have 40 million users, making Padlet one of the most used apps on the planet.
Money: We are venture backed AND fiscally responsible. We are built to last one hundred years.
Badassery: We are only 60 odd people. That's over half a million active users per person.
Joys of designing at Padlet
We don't design with data or A/B tests unless we really don't know what the right answer is.
We ship. Your work will not be stuck in purgatory for years.
Your work will have a tremendous impact on global education.
Every artist craves an audience. You'll start with 40 million.
We value quality and craft.
We don't take ourselves too seriously.
Sorrows of designing at Padlet
We don't design with data or A/B tests unless we really don't know what the right answer is.
CEO has very strong opinions about design and can often be incorrigible.
Work can be chaotic. "Change of plans. Let's do this instead." is not uncommon.
You will get hate mail whenever you redesign something. Many users feel very strongly about the product.
Some people you‘d be working with
Brian Koh: Only human we know who has impulsive urges to exercise. When he does, he doesn't care about outfits. We've seen him running in boots, tight jeans, and leather jackets. Exceptional engineer and even better mentor.
Gerard Searchfield: Insists that wallabies and kangaroos are different animals, artificially inflating the biodiversity of his homeland. Will notice a 1px misalignment from 18 feet away.
The office
We have a beautiful office in the historic Bukit Pasoh Neighbourhood.
1 minute walk from Outram Park MRT.
We have a lovely balcony. It's really, truly lovely.
Designed to be a space to inspire creativity and collaboration.
Benefits
Medical and dental insurance for you and your family.
Stock options.
Catered lunches and dinners. Military grade snacking.
20 vacation days. Plus sickness and bereavement days for when life happens.
Parental leave.
All the gadgetry you need, including a new phone every year.
Badassery budget to level up.
Special time to join
Because we're small, we move fast. And because we have tremendous traction, your designs will go in the hands of millions. This combination of speed and impact is rare and quite satisfying.

title: Product Designer
description:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 750 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.
We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets.
🌲 About Spruce
Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.
We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.
We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…
🥖 The Role
You’ll be central to our mission as we turn historically slow and painful processes into ones that are quick, intuitive and even delightful for installers. We’ve been design-led since the beginning but the challenge is only growing as our product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you’ll be:
Making complex decisions feel effortless – Our platform handles everything from building physics calculations to fluid dynamics modelling to complicated compliance requirements. We need to make handling that complexity feel effortless for all our customers, irrespective of how tech-savvy they are.
Designing across multiple touchpoints – You'll work on desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work seamlessly across different user types (from 3-person local installers to national utilities);
Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs can be shipped quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team);
Building systematic, scalable design systems – Creating robust, structured, and reusable components that work across platforms and for potentially low-tech users;
Researching and validating - Interviewing and spending time with installers to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems to solve are; and building quick prototypes to test and validate design decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.
You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.
🫵 About You
We’re looking for a designer with
3+ years of product/UI design experience
(and potentially a lot more), ideally in a startup context or within fast-paced, impact-focussed teams. We'd love to speak with you if you are:
A clear, systematic thinker who loves tackling complex flows;
Comfortable with diving into technical detail, even if it’s a new domain;
User-obsessed; you enjoy deeply understanding the user, solving their problems and making a tangible impact on them;
Great with people and confident running research with customers;
Proactive and self-organising, happy juggling multiple projects;
Bonus if you’ve worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or on operational workflows (but absolutely not a requirement!).
🌟 Our offer
💰 £60-110k salary, depending on experience.
🍰 Meaningful slice of equity (options) in the company
🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year
🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight
🏥 Private Medical Cover
👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)
🚲 Cycle to Work scheme
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow
🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce
We’re currently a close-knit team of 28, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.
You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.
We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. This is clearly particularly important for this role but you’ll be surrounded by a whole team who are also close to our customers.
We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.
Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.
Compensation Range: £60K - £110K

title: Product Designer
description:
Location:
Singapore
Company:
Nas.com
Nas.com is building Shopify for the AI era: a platform that helps net-new entrepreneurs find customers and sell online. We’re an AI-first business platform used by 16,000+ entrepreneurs, growing rapidly month over month, and we scaled revenue 5× in 2025.
Backed by leading Silicon Valley VCs and based in Singapore, we’re entering a critical scale phase.
Why Work With Us
Here, you are not just an employee — you are treated as a true owner of the company. Our CEO shares clear updates on business strategy and operations every week, and your ideas are always welcome. You’ll have direct access to leadership, and strong support to turn great ideas into reality.
You’ll work alongside a team of highly intelligent, passionate, and execution-driven engineers, using some of the most advanced AI technologies in the industry to solve real problems for users around the world.
We’re looking for our
third Product Designer
to join our team of passionate product builders. As a design-centric company, designers play a crucial role in shaping both the product and the experience for our users. Our mission is to create the simplest and most beautiful experience for creators who want to build an online business and turn customers into community. We’re looking for a passionate, curious, and self-driven product designer who sweats the details and has excellent taste. You’ll enjoy autonomy, ownership, and a significant impact across the product and company.
About You
You care deeply about your craft: You have strong attention to detail, a drive for simplicity, and an understanding of how small nuances come together to create seamless, intuitive designs. You’re always looking for ways to improve.
You’re an intentional and holistic thinker: You’re thoughtful in your design decisions and understand their impact on both the business and users. You consider broader perspectives, such as product vision and cross-functional collaboration with systems and engineering teams.
You take ownership: You act as a leader on the projects you drive. You independently manage your timeline and engage with stakeholders to see projects through to completion.
You’re adaptable: You pivot when needed, embrace iteration, and work at pace, providing vision and direction even in the face of ambiguity.
You’re balanced: Beyond your craft, you’re a well-rounded contributor who values business context, relationships, trade-offs, and collaboration.
What You’ll Do Each Day
Lead end-to-end design projects, from exploration and ideation to execution and polish.
Transform complex problems into high-quality, beautiful, and seamless designs across mobile and web platforms for Nas.io.
Collaborate directly with the founder, team leads, and product and engineering teams to shape overall strategy and product direction.
Join and contribute to product meetings and design reviews with our founder/CEO.
Partner closely with engineers during design hand-offs and pre-launch phases to ensure a high-quality implementation.
Express your ideas through tools like Figma, Jitter, and Framer.
Solve user problems while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency.
Push the boundaries of what great product design looks like and help shape the design culture within the company.
Why This Role Is Unique
Work directly with the founder (also CEO) and leadership to influence how our product is designed and developed.
See your designs come to life in days, with real global impact.
Enjoy autonomy and ownership to shape your role and grow it in the direction you want.
Be part of a fast-growing, design-centric company moving at SUPA-fast speed!
Collaborate with ambitious, driven teammates from around the world.
Grow your career as the company scales.
What You’ll Need
3+ years of professional product design experience (bonus if you have SaaS or e-commerce experience).
Proficiency and confidence with Figma (bonus points if you’re also skilled in Framer and Jitter).
Ability to adapt and thrive in a high-growth environment.
Passion, self-drive, resilience, and a love for solving challenges.
A sharp eye for detail and strong design taste that aligns with our brand while raising the bar for the team.
Excellent communication and presentation skills—you can clearly articulate your design rationale and vision through compelling storytelling.
Basic copywriting skills.
Familiarity with Nas.io’s design language and product.
A portfolio showcasing your best product design work.
Our Company Values
Think in Days: We don't think about how many years something will take, we think about how many days. This is our secret to fast growth.
Always Share Secrets: We don't believe in secrets. We share with our followers and our employees what we do and why we do it.
Never Miss a Monday: We never miss a meeting. We never miss a deadline. We never miss a commitment. Commitment is at the core of our DNA.
Be A Force For Good: All our actions intend to bring a positive impact to everyone around us.
Explain for a 10-year old: We communicate in a simple and inclusive manner, free from unnecessary complexity.
Benefits
At Nas Company, we work hard, REALLY HARD! So we value our employees' well-being and believe that a supportive and fulfilling work environment contributes to their success. We're proud to offer a range of benefits that will enhance your professional and personal life. Here's what you can look forward to as part of our team:
😷 Medical Insurance
: We care about your health. Our comprehensive medical insurance plans are tailored to each region, ensuring you have the coverage you need.
🧘🏽 Self Care/Wellness Fund
: Your well-being matters. We provide a monthly fund of $100 to spend on activities that bring you joy and promote your self-care.
🧠
Mental Health Fund:
We care about your mental health too! We provide a monthly fund of $150 to spend on therapy or career coaching.
🏖️ Yearly Retreats
: Unwind, bond, and collaborate at our annual company retreats. A time for the entire company to come together to rejuvenate and bond.
💰 Stock Options
: As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to potentially own a piece of the company through stock options or profit sharing, depending on company discretion, aligning your success with ours.

title: Product Designer
description:
Hiive is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional-grade platform, Hiive brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture-backed, pre-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.
Recognized as one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Hiive is profitable, well-capitalized, and building a high-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.
Interested in learning more about life at Hiive? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!
As a
Product Designer
at Hiive, you’ll join a fast-growing, high-impact product team. You’ll work within a modern tech stack alongside strong Design, Product, and Engineering partners who move quickly yet also care deeply about craft. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up fast, collaborate cross-functionally, and help drive meaningful, measurable outcomes for the business.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Include
Leading the design of product features and initiatives, from conceptualization to high-fidelity execution.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and other designers, to define product requirements and design solutions that meet both user needs and business goals.
Conducting user research, usability testing, and gathering feedback to iterate and improve design solutions.
Designing for both web and mobile, with a focus on creating intuitive and delightful user experiences across devices.
Owning and evolving the visual and interaction design of the product, ensuring high-quality, pixel-perfect designs.
Leading design reviews and presenting design concepts to stakeholders across the company.
Supporting others around you, championing the company values with a positive outlook.
Responding effectively and respectfully to various working conditions with a growth mindset.
Required Experience
3–5 years of professional design experience.
Mastery in Figma and other applicable design software.
Relevant experience with different design methods and techniques.
An online or PDF portfolio (please include any passwords).
Preferred Experience
Previous experience working in a Fintech startup or designing for marketplaces.
Previous experience facilitating research and user testing.
Ability to adapt well in quickly changing environments.
Compensation, Benefits & Perks
Highly competitive salary commensurate with experience and contribution.
Opportunity to participate in ownership of a rapidly growing company through our employee stock option plan.
Comprehensive 100% employer-paid health & dental premiums and a Health/Personal Spending Account for Canadian employees. (An employer-subsidized benefits program is available for US-based team members).
If you are based in Vancouver, enjoy a dedicated desk in our Vancouver, BC HQ, in the heart of downtown, with a fridge stocked with healthy snacks and drinks, an onsite gym, and a gorgeous rooftop amenity.
Enjoy a $20-per-day commuter benefit for every day you work in our Vancouver HQ.
An engaging social calendar, including bi-weekly catered lunches, bi-weekly “Friday bar,” team workouts, annual summer party, and holiday party, two “onsite” all-team retreats each year, semi-annual team-building events, and Hiive Women’s Network events.
Significant opportunities for growth into team leadership and management roles.
Entrepreneurial culture and a small and dynamic team.
Sponsorship, immigration, and relocation for exceptional candidates.
Hiive is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed.
AI, Automated Tools, And Applicant Privacy Notice
As part of our recruitment and hiring process, Hiive may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist in screening applications, evaluating candidate qualifications, and supporting interview processes. These tools are designed to support and inform human decision-making and are not used as the sole basis for any employment decision.
We may collect, use, and analyze personal information you provide in connection with your application, including generating insights or inferences to assess job-related qualifications. This information is used for recruitment, evaluation, and compliance purposes in accordance with applicable law.
We take reasonable steps to evaluate and monitor our hiring tools and practices to promote fairness, consistency, and non-discrimination. Where required by applicable law - including in Ontario, Quebec, New York City, Illinois, and California - we conduct or rely on assessments such as bias audits, honor rights related to automated decision-making, and provide additional disclosures on request.
Depending on your location, you may have certain rights with respect to your personal information and the use of automated processing, including the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information, or to receive additional information about our data practices. We honor such rights where required by applicable law.
For accommodation requests or questions about this notice, contact careers@hiive.com.

title: Product Designer
description:
"The AI company that's revolutionizing Hollywood"
Flawless is transforming Hollywood with assistive AI.
Our tools empower filmmakers to edit, localize, and refine performances while preserving artistic intent.
Designed to support, not replace, artists, our technology expands what is possible on screen and gives creators freedom to tell stories with greater impact and reach audiences in new ways. From enabling seamless multilingual releases to eliminating the need for costly reshoots, Flawless solves critical challenges that slow down productions and limit distribution.
We are also setting the standard for ethical AI in entertainment. Our Artistic Rights Treasury (A.R.T.) is a rights management solution that protects artists and rights holders, ensuring that innovation moves forward with transparency and respect for creative ownership.
About This Role
In this role, you'll provide dedicated design capacity for our high-priority TrueSync workflows, increasing our operational effectiveness and reducing bottlenecks. You'll have a direct impact on product quality and throughput by taking ownership of workflows that support review efficiency and usability.
Your work will reduce delivery risk by replacing inconsistent contractor support with a permanent hire who can build deep context and accountability. You’ll also free up our Design Lead to focus on broader product vision and quality standards. You'll directly support our company goal of enabling one user to create one hour of vubbed content in one day by improving the speed and clarity of our review and refinement tools.
Reports to
Tom Nicholls - Lead Product Designer
What we are looking for
We're looking for a proactive and coachable mid-level product designer with solid fundamentals across UX, interaction, and visual design. You should be comfortable owning the full design process—from problem framing to handoff—in a fast-moving environment. You'll be a strong collaborator who can clearly explain design decisions and work closely with product and engineering to ship features for complex digital products.
Responsibilities
You'll own design work across the full process, including problem framing, concepting, prototyping, testing, iteration, and handoff.
You'll contribute to our goal of enabling one user to create one hour of vubbed content in one day by improving the speed and clarity of key workflows in TrueSync.
You'll use AI tools like Cursor and Claude Code to explore and communicate solutions quickly, producing clear, testable POCs before development begins.
You'll talk directly with internal and external users to understand pain points, validate solutions, and improve your decisions.
You'll collaborate with Product and Engineering, helping to shape user stories and requirements so developers can build with confidence.
You'll design workflows that handle ambiguity, system status, and complex user decisions.
Your Experience
Solid product design fundamentals across Product Design (UX, and UI design).
Experience designing and shipping features for complex digital products with Product and Engineering teams.
Ability to own design work across the full process: problem framing, concepting, prototyping, testing, iteration, and handoff.
Strong prototyping skills, including the ability to use AI tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
Comfortable talking to users, running lightweight research, and using feedback to improve designs.
Strong communication skills, especially in explaining design decisions to PMs and developers.
Ability to help shape user stories, requirements, and design guidance for engineers.
Strong judgement in designing workflows that involve ambiguity and complex user decisions.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the process is still being defined.
Coachable, proactive, and able to grow into greater ownership over time.
Bonus Points For
Experience working on creative editing tools, AI products, or complex workflow software.
Experience with review, asset, media, or refinement-style workflows.
Familiarity designing for both novice and expert users.
Experience contributing to a new design process within a team.
Confidence contributing to critique and design direction outside your immediate area of ownership.
In your first 6 months you will
You’ll take ownership of meaningful design work across our product surfaces.
You’ll produce clear, testable solution ideas using AI-driven prototyping workflows.
You’ll contribute to the company goal of enabling one user to create one hour of vubbed content in one day.
You’ll become dependable enough to own small-to-medium design problems with limited oversight.
Why work at Flawless?

Autonomy

title: Product Designer
description:
Join Bud's winning team
Product Designer
As Bud continues to grow, we're looking for a Product Designer to join our Product Department and add vital design capacity across our platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, working alongside our Senior Product Designer and reporting into the Head of Product.
You'll take ownership of design work across defined product areas, supporting the delivery of new features and improvements to Bud's platform. You'll collaborate closely with Product Owners and Developers to turn requirements into well-crafted, accessible user experiences, while learning from and contributing to the design system and practices established by the senior design function.
This role is ideal for a designer who wants to grow their craft, take on real ownership of features, and be part of building out a growing design capability — with support and mentorship from a senior designer close at hand.
Key Accountabilities
Design user journeys and interfaces for assigned features and product areas, producing wireframes, flows, prototypes, and developer-ready UI in Figma.
Take ownership of UX and UI decisions within your product areas, under the guidance of the Senior Product Designer and Head of Product.
Apply Bud's accessibility standards, ensuring your work meets WCAG 2.2 AA guidelines.
Use and contribute to Bud's design system and component libraries, flagging gaps or improvement opportunities to the Senior Product Designer.
Partner with Product Owners and Developers to understand requirements, ask the right questions early, and support high-quality delivery.
Incorporate research insights, data, and user feedback into your design decisions, iterating post-launch where needed.
Participate actively in design critiques, sharing work openly and applying feedback constructively.
Support the wider Product team's ways of working, following established UX processes and standards.
Perform any other reasonable duties or tasks as required by the organisation in line with the role's purpose and operational needs.
You Must Have
Solid experience designing UX and UI for web-based products, ideally within a SaaS or platform environment.
Good working proficiency in Figma, including component-based design and prototyping.
An understanding of accessibility and inclusive design principles, with willingness to develop practical WCAG 2.2 AA expertise.
Ability to translate clear requirements into well-considered, user-centred solutions.
A portfolio demonstrating solid UX thinking and visual design craft across product work.
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain your design thinking and take on feedback.
A collaborative, proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and grow within the role.
The Team
You'll sit within the Product Department, working day-to-day alongside the Senior Product Designer, Product Owners, and Developers, and collaborating with QA, Customer Success, and Sales as needed. You'll report to the Head of Product, who will support your development alongside the guidance and mentorship you'll receive from the Senior Product Designer.
About Bud
Established in 2016, Bud is the next generation SaaS platform, supporting some of the largest organisations in the skills development and apprenticeship training sector. With over 70,000 users and growing year on year, backed by venture capital, we are on an exciting journey, to expand our client base throughout the UK.
At Bud, we’re passionate and proud to be engineering a solution that will enable more and more learners to access consistent, high-quality training and for training providers to maximise their business opportunities. Our customers love Bud because it enables them to drive up the quality of their training delivery at scale whilst reducing costs.
As innovators, we’re constantly looking for new ways to improve training and learner outcomes through technology, and we’re working on a number of exciting new product areas right now.
This is a great time to be joining the business as we continue to flourish with strong revenue growth and increasing our workforce.
Working at Bud
We have a strong leadership team and a clear vision that has been translated into a sound business strategy: Each department aligning their strategic direction to the overarching organisational goals.
We are supportive and collaborative, working together to create a unique culture, where people thrive and build rewarding careers. We share a work ethic that provides the perfect blend of autonomy, professionalism and accountability, with a desire to have fun along the way.
Bud operates a hybrid working model. We believe in striking the right balance between remote and office working, ensuring connected teams, forging internal relations, whilst allowing our colleagues to do their best work both from home and our main office in Berkeley Square, Bristol.
The Bud culture and values
At Bud, we strive to build a culture rooted in our core values.
Accountability
is key, with each team member taking ownership of their contributions, fostering trust and dependability across the organisation.
We promote
collaborative
teamwork through open communication and mutual support, ensuring that ideas are shared freely, and everyone’s voice is heard and valued.
Our commitment to
excellence
means we consistently push for continuous improvement, setting and achieving high standards, and celebrating our successes along the way.
Passion
fuels our efforts, driving us to pursue our goals with dedication, energy, and enthusiasm.
We also embrace an
entrepreneurial
mindset, cultivating a culture of innovation where new ideas are welcomed, and calculated risks are taken to achieve growth.

title: Product Designer, Internal Tools
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team
You'll work closely with several teams of engineers and PMs to shape products used by Stripe employees across engineering, operations, finance, and beyond. This is a high-impact role for a designer who finds as much satisfaction in untangling complex workflows and dense information architectures as in crafting polished interfaces.
What you'll do
You'll take ownership of two spaces within our internal tooling portfolio—Developer Productivity, focused on ensuring every engineer at Stripe has the tools to be productive, and Collaboration, focused on knowledge discovery and communication at scale. You'll pair with an existing designer on the team to bring design quality and consistency to surfaces that are critical to how Stripe operates internally.
Responsibilities
Own end-to-end design for a portfolio of internal tools—from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, prototyping, and implementation support
Partner with engineering and product managers to define product requirements and translate them into clear, usable, and well-considered design solutions
Conduct lightweight research and usability sessions with internal users to validate decisions and surface unmet needs
Contribute to a consistent design language across our internal tools suite, working in close coordination with the Sail Design team and the Stripe design system
Make design trade-offs confidently, knowing when to go deep on craft and when to ship a pragmatic solution that moves the product forward
Help raise the bar for internal product design at Stripe, advocating for users who are often underserved compared to customer-facing surfaces
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements
5+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong UX thinking, clear visual craft, and an ability to navigate ambiguity
Experience designing tools for complex or data-heavy workflows—internal tools, developer tools, ops platforms, or similar are a strong plus
Comfortable working across the full design process—you can lead discovery, write a problem brief, design and prototype, and ship without needing every step handed to you
Strong systems thinker—you naturally look for patterns, reusable components, and structural solutions rather than one-off fixes
Collaborative and direct communicator. You share work early, give and receive feedback well, and know how to align cross-functional stakeholders
Proficient in Figma and comfortable working within or alongside a design system
Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing for internal-facing or enterprise tooling environments
You've contributed to a design system, or worked closely to a design systems team
Exposure to information architecture challenges—navigation, search, and content modeling
Background in or interest in developer tooling, ops platforms, or workflow automation
Hybrid work at Stripe
This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.
Working remotely at Stripe
A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.
Pay and benefits
The annual US base salary range for this role is $159,300 - $238,900. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
